runAsk could be called directly with oversized question or harnessMemory before downstream provider/search/weather work.
GET /api/weather accepted unbounded question text and concurrent equivalent cold misses could each trigger fixed multi-signal upstream fan-out.

patchContract.attackerControlledInput: Public request body or query string values that select question text, harness memory, raw knowledge events, or remediation document text.
patchContract.securityInvariant: Public routes must reject over-budget work before DB search, public API fan-out, or model invocation; equivalent in-flight weather lookups must share one upstream fetch promise.
legitimateBehaviorPreserved: Bounded ask JSON and SSE requests still attach generation evidence.
Knowledge candidates remain stateless, unpublished, and human-review-only.
Workpack remediation still returns readable SIF labels and bounded source summaries.
Weather route keeps existing fetchWeatherSignal behavior, timeout/retry behavior, and response shape for accepted questions.
